description: A adds a parameter to scale() and updates its one call site; B edits an independent variable. A signature change is a *fullName* change, so under the step-17 correspondence the old method is deleted and a new one added - the same delete+add treatment as a rename - and B's edit merges around it. Git conflicts (A's two edits straddle B's line), the semantics merges, and the merged program is the one both developers intended: A's two-argument scale with B's value.
category: false textual conflict — semantics merges it (signature change)
